description: Enemy prefixes rolled when a room's enemy is created (and the final boss's Demon mark). A prefix renames the enemy, adds its tags (StatusAffinities.json reads them for immunities and weaknesses) and adds its effects as enemy affixes (EnemyAffixRuntime levers: hp / damage / speed (belowHealth gates) / onhit / start / taken (weapons filter) / evasion (stacks = hit faces) / extraaction (stacks = signature actions)). The Demon's mechanics come from EnemyAffixes.json.

prefixes.name: Demon
prefixes.description: Final-boss mark: signature kit, region affix a rank up, dungeon affix and a second phase at 50% HP (EnemyAffixes.json).

prefixes.name: Undead
prefixes.description: +15% HP. Immune to Poison and Bleed, takes 1.5x Burn.

prefixes.name: Skeleton
prefixes.description: Takes 25% less from swords and daggers, 30% more from maces. Immune to Poison and Bleed.

prefixes.name: Ghost
prefixes.description: Takes 30% less from maces, swords and daggers (wands hit it normally). Immune to Poison and Bleed.

prefixes.name: Tiny
prefixes.description: -25% HP, swings 20% faster, and you need 1 higher to hit it.

prefixes.name: Armored
prefixes.description: Starts each fight with 3 Fortify. Takes 2x Acid.

prefixes.name: Ancient
prefixes.description: +10% HP and one more action from its dungeon's signature kit.

prefixes.name: Blazing
prefixes.description: 30% chance to Burn on hit. Immune to Burn.

prefixes.name: Frozen
prefixes.description: 30% chance to Slow on hit, but brittle: takes 15% more damage and 2x Burn.

prefixes.name: Venomous
prefixes.description: 30% chance to Poison on hit (0.25% max HP per tick). Immune to Poison.

prefixes.name: Hallowed
prefixes.description: +15% HP and starts each fight with 1 Harden. Immune to Weaken.
